stories.summary: America’s future depends on progressive, anti-establishment fighters Welcome back to How We Win , a Guardian opinion series with leading thinkers, offering bold ideas for America’s political future. Last week, Naomi Klein , Guardian US columnist, argued for taking on the billionaire class . Today’s edition was written by Wajahat Ali, editor of The Left Hook and co-host of The Democracy-ish Podcast. Change is slow, and then, once in a while, all of a sudden. The future of America depends on progressive, anti-establishment fighters to champion a politics of transformation. Tax billionaires. Medicare for All. Abolish ICE and put forth an immigration reform policy that centers both humanity and security. Call out Israel’s genocide and withhold money and weapons from foreign countries that commit war crimes with our resources. A living wage. Reject corporate Pac money and deliver campaign finance reform. Combat climate change and move away from fossil fuels. Expand and aggressively reform the supreme court, because without that, we get nothing. Deliver accountability for “the Epstein class”, a transnational syndicate of powerful billionaires who commit crimes with impunity. Never sacrifice or abandon any marginalized group in our pursuit of affordability and accountability. Continue reading...

General Trending.summary: America’s future depends on progressive, anti-establishment fighters Welcome back to How We Win , a Guardian opinion series with leading thinkers, offering bold ideas for America’s political future. Last week, Naomi Klein , Guardian US columnist, argued for taking on the billionaire class . Today’s edition was written by Wajahat Ali, editor of The Left Hook and co-host of The Democracy-ish Podcast. Change is slow, and then, once in a while, all of a sudden. The future of America depends on progressive, anti-establishment fighters to champion a politics of transformation. Tax billionaires. Medicare for All. Abolish ICE and put forth an immigration reform policy that centers both humanity and security. Call out Israel’s genocide and withhold money and weapons from foreign countries that commit war crimes with our resources. A living wage. Reject corporate Pac money and deliver campaign finance reform. Combat climate change and move away from fossil fuels. Expand and aggressively reform the supreme court, because without that, we get nothing. Deliver accountability for “the Epstein class”, a transnational syndicate of powerful billionaires who commit crimes with impunity. Never sacrifice or abandon any marginalized group in our pursuit of affordability and accountability. Continue reading...
